# State Class View (variant): Restoration and land stewardship project lead (local)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> All task importance, time share, critical, needed-at-entry and target-level values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Credential gates and sign-off are shown only as drafts until an E-labelled source is attached.

- **Role:** Restoration and land stewardship project lead (`seed:R09-restoration-project-lead`, P1); authority position (editorial): resource-manager
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.1.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (proposed), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Implement ecological restoration treatments and adapt them to site response — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Work alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Read site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Map the decision authority and procedural pathway for a proposed action — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Assess species habitat requirements and habitat condition — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Recognize and assess ecosystems that have crossed into novel states — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Administer contracts, grants and intergovernmental agreements — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
